title: Rosalind and the Extraction
author: Ivo Marchetti
blurb: Jude Eriksen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
